title: Fubini exchange for a primitive composed with a measurable radius (common core of parent Steps 8 and 9)
statement: Let (X, 𝒜) be a measurable space (formally a type X : Type, which covers both uses X = ℝ and X = ℝ^{n+ℓ}), ν an s-finite measure on X, S ∈ 𝒜, r: X → ℝ measurable, g: X → ℝ, F, F′: ℝ → ℝ and σ, ρ ∈ ℝ. Assume r(x) ∈ (σ, ρ] for every x ∈ S, g is ν-integrable on S, F′ is Lebesgue integrable on (σ, ρ], and F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]} F′(τ)dτ for every t ∈ [σ, ρ]. Then (a) x ↦ g(x)(F(r(x)) − F(σ)) is ν-integrable on S; (b) t ↦ F′(t)·∫_{S ∩ {x : t < r(x)}} g dν is Lebesgue integrable on (σ, ρ]; and (c) ∫_{(σ,ρ]} F′(t)(∫_{S ∩ {x : t < r(x)}} g dν)dt = ∫_S g(x)(F(r(x)) − F(σ))dν(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (S : Set X) (r g : X → ℝ) (F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), SFinite ν → MeasurableSet S → Measurable r → (∀ x ∈ S, r x ∈ Ioc σ ρ) → IntegrableOn g S ν → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ g x * (F (r x) - F σ)) S ν ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t ↦ F' t * ∫ x in S ∩ {x | t < r x}, g x ∂ν) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ ∫ t in Ioc σ ρ, F' t * ∫ x in S ∩ {x | t < r x}, g x ∂ν = ∫ x in S, g x * (F (r x) - F σ) ∂ν
